about: Canonical, machine-readable recording of the character budgets the suno-helper tools enforce. Suno does not publish a stable official specification for the web app, so every number carries its provenance and confidence. Tools read THIS file; prose guides link to it instead of restating numbers.

v5.5.note: personalization layer over v5 audio engine

quality_guidance.front_load_terms: Suno weights earlier terms more heavily; put genre + vocal character in the first 20-30 words.
quality_guidance.brackets: Square brackets are structure tags inside the Lyrics field. Do not wrap BPM or key in brackets inside the Style field.

rules: Never present these application defaults as official Suno limits.
Never truncate user-approved lyrics silently; surface the overflow instead.
Prefer the Exclude Styles field over negative phrasing inside Style.
Older-model guidance must be labelled with its model.
